#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <climits>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int minimum = INT_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] < minimum) {
            minimum = a[i];
        }

    int last_min_index = -1;

            if (last_min_index != -1) {
                min_distance = std::min(min_distance, i - last_min_index);

            last_min_index = i;
        }
    }

    std::cout << min_distance << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
